name: FV_CFG_USSGL_ACCOUNTS_
description: This table contains information about U.S. Standard General Ledger Accounts.

columns.name: USSGL_ACCOUNT_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for the U.S. Standard General Ledger account.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: USSGL_ACCOUNT
columns.description: A six-digit number used to identify a specific U.S. Standard General Ledger account. The U.S. Standard General Ledger account must be in the U.S. Standard General Ledger chart of accounts.

columns.name: USSGL_ACCOUNT_DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Description of the U.S. Standard General Ledger account.

columns.name: NATURAL_ACCT_BALANCE_CODE
columns.description: Identifies the normal balance of a U.S. Standard General Ledger account as a debit or credit.

columns.name: BUDGET_SPENDING_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Identifies if a U.S. Standard General Ledger account is commitment, obligation, or expenditure account.

columns.name: DATA_ACT_REPORTING_CODE
columns.description: Identifies a U.S. Standard General Ledger account as Data Act reportable.

columns.name: ACTIVE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if an object is active or inactive.
